patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Lightspeed Retail and Salesforce Commerce Cloud share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Frame: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Lightspeed Retail and Salesforce Commerce Cloud share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.. Choose Lightspeed Retail only if your buying job matches “Retail POS + omnichannel — Basic $89/mo, Core $149 highlighted, Plus $289/mo USD; Lightspe” rather than Salesforce Commerce Cloud's shape. Choose Salesforce Commerce Cloud only if your buying job matches “Salesforce B2C Commerce (ex-Demandware) — Growth/Plus/Premium are GMV-percent quote only; ” rather than Lightspeed Retail's shape. Workflow advantage: Lightspeed Retail leans omnichannel-retail; Salesforce Commerce Cloud leans wholesale-b2b, catalog-management. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Lightspeed Retail and Salesforce Commerce Cloud share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Lightspeed Retail is Retail POS + omnichannel — Basic $89/mo, Core $149 highlighted, Plus $289/mo USD; Lightspeed Payments ~1.5% card-present; eCommerce on highe; Salesforce Commerce Cloud is Salesforce B2C Commerce (ex-Demandware) — Growth/Plus/Premium are GMV-percent quote only; enterprise SaaS landscape, not an SMB Shopify subs.
- Company-size focus: Lightspeed Retail (small-business, mid-market) vs Salesforce Commerce Cloud (mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Lightspeed Retail-leaning omnichannel-retail vs Salesforce Commerce Cloud-leaning wholesale-b2b, catalog-management.
- Researched limits: Lightspeed Retail — No free plan or documented self-serve trial — contact sales is the common path; Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Pricing is opaque GMV-% — hard to compare without a Salesforce worksheet.

Limitations — Lightspeed Retail: No free plan or documented self-serve trial — contact sales is the common path; Third-party payment processors may incur a high monthly surcharge versus Lightspeed Payments (~1.5% card-present) — confirm live; Salesforce Commerce Cloud: Pricing is opaque GMV-% — hard to compare without a Salesforce worksheet; Implementation is a multi-month SI programme, not a weekend theme install.

Poor-fit cases: Lightspeed Retail is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No free plan or documented self-serve trial — contact sales is the common path · Salesforce Commerce Cloud is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Pricing is opaque GMV-% — hard to compare without a Salesforce worksheet · Avoid Lightspeed Retail if you actually need Salesforce Commerce Cloud's motion (Salesforce B2C Commerce (ex-Demandware) — Growth/Plus/Premium are GMV-percent qu)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
